Gross technical provisions

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding reduced from 3,238.5 (yearend 2013) to 3,116.7 at 31 December 2014. The technical provisions note shows a gross movement in the claims provision of -54.6m (a release) during 2014 together with exchange adjustments which further reduced the reported sterlingequivalent balance. This release reflects favourable claims development across prior years rather than material oneoff named events.
raw_causal_phrases: Change in the gross provision for claims 15 54.6 56.2
data.data_quality_notes: Amounts extracted from the statutory financial statements which are denominated in US dollars. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (liabilities: claims outstanding) 2013 comparative column. Prior year movement taken from the Technical Provisions reconciliation table (gross 'Movement in the provision' for claims outstanding = (54.6)  interpreted as a release of 54.6). No claims development triangle or explicit LOBlevel prior year reserve movements were found. No specific named loss events affecting prior year reserves were identified in the available pages.
